'''Nullicaine''' was a drug with pain numbing properties.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] injured her foot while practicing with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kornell Divini]] treated her injury and almost sprayed the wound with nullicaine, then remembered that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had a way of shutting off pain using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
